title: Gallery Shutter
description: Choose fragment count and fracture pattern. Each cycle reassembles the scene, then opens new crack paths in new directions and order, with musical stage exposures.

parameters.label: Fragments
parameters.description: Number of independently moving scene fragments.

parameters.label: Fracture Pattern
parameters.description: Choose the fracture layout. Each opening cycle develops new crack paths, directions and timing.

parameters.label: Dream
parameters.description: Balance fragments of present reality and its dream.

parameters.label: Separation
parameters.description: Separate the scene fragments in depth and open the fractures.

parameters.label: Time Slip
parameters.description: Shear and offset the fragments in staggered phases.

parameters.label: Pace
parameters.description: Pace of the fracture and reassembly wave.

parameters.label: Spectrum
parameters.description: Color registration and illuminated shard edges.

parameters.label: Glitch
parameters.description: Tear selected image regions into displaced strips and broken signal blocks.

parameters.label: Beat Cut
parameters.description: Perform negative, torn, chromatic, ghost and solarized exposures on musical attacks.

parameters.label: Effect
parameters.description: Blend the fragmented scene with Source A.

provenance.prompt_summary: Add count and fracture-pattern controls. After each reassembly, choose new crack positions, opening directions and order. Hold paths steady within each cycle; keep clean edges and musical stage exposures.
